notes:
AE notes / call highlights:
- Customer: BlueHarvest builds a knowledge layer for mid-market SaaS clients (in-app help, product search, agent retrieval). Primary focus: embeddings + semantic search.
- Current infra: Postgres+pgvector for production, nightly batch jobs to embed new docs (avg 200k docs/day in peak). Considering move to Dedicated to reduce unit cost and guarantee throughput.
- Targets/requirements:
  * Throughput: sustained 150-250 embed reqs/s during nightly batch windows, spike to 400 qps for on-demand embed API from workers.
  * Latency: p95 vector similarity lookup <60ms end-to-end; search response to user <200ms for chat-like UX.
  * Batch jobs: ability to run ~5M doc embedding passes per month with predictable billing.
  * Integration: want guidance on vector DB coupling (keep pgvector vs pinecone/weaviate/milvus) — concerned about migration complexity and index rebuild times.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required by customers, SSO/SAML for staff, audit logs retention 12 months, data residency preference for NA. Need KMS integration for keys.
- POC specifics: started on Hosted API to validate embedding quality and retrieval; moved to a perf POC to measure cost/throughput. Hosted results show acceptable quality but unit cost + network egress at scale is pushing them toward Dedicated.
- Pricing ask: show T-shirt reserved tiers, and a throughput-based tier (committed qps) + overage. They want a modeled TCO comparison vs Pinecone + self-hosted Milvus on same infra.
- Quotes from call: "Hosted gives us a fast sanity check — but we need predictable bills and <200ms SLAs for customers."
- Internal notes: SE (Daniel) to run dedicated perf run w/ 4x batch worker concurrency and KV cache enabled; measure tokenization CPU vs GPU embed throughput. Deliver perf PDF and cost model by 2025-03-14.
- Risks: large index rebuilds (5M+) could impact search quality and ingestion windows; procurement timeline aligns with fiscal May close.
- Good signals: already used Hosted API in prod trials, engineering team engaged, procurement open to 12-month reserved commitment if numbers match.
- Next meetings scheduled: security handoff (2025-03-16), pricing review with procurement (2025-03-20).
sales_play_notes: Approach: 1) complete perf numbers on Dedicated (SLA proof), 2) deliver side-by-side TCO + migration plan for pgvector -> vendor or managed vector DB, 3) offer limited initial reserved commit with quarterly review. Emphasize caching + batching optimizations in Redwood Optimize to reduce bill. SE action: produce small runbook for index rebuild / incremental reindexing to address their migration concerns.
